name: Penrose Tiling
desc: An aperiodic Penrose P3 rhombus quasilattice grown by deflation into a fivefold sun of gold-and-bronze rhombs on deep indigo, slowly turning while a luminous inflation-front sweeps the tiles outward, in gilt-manuscript, drafting blueprint, neon strapwork, riso duotone and sumi-ink renderings.

density.doc: deflation depth 3..5 (chunky rhombs .. fine quasilattice) - rebuilds

scale.doc: rhombus size / zoom (small tight tiling .. large bold rhombs) - rebuilds

glow.doc: width of the sweeping inflation glow-front

style.doc: render philosophy: gilt-manuscript gold-on-indigo mass / cyan drafting schematic with guide circles / additive neon strapwork / two-ink riso duotone with misregistration / sumi single-ink dry-brush

seed.doc: deterministic sun phase + per-tile tone jitter (rebuilds cache)

act.doc: dramaturgy: front sweeps outward / whole quasilattice turns / fully-lit beat pulses
